# TechDotBit

> TechDotBit (TechDotBit Private Limited) is a software and AI company based in Noida, Delhi NCR, India. It builds DotOne, an AI-powered, industry-specific ERP for Indian manufacturers, distributors and growing businesses, and provides AI agent development, custom software, mobile app and web development services.

Key facts:

- DotOne is TechDotBit's ERP product. Its product website is https://dotone.in/ and the ERP section of this site is https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/.
- DotOne covers CRM, sales, purchase, inventory, production, quality, job work, dispatch, GST accounting, HR and analytics, with AI agents and a mobile app. It is configured per industry (for example plywood, adhesive tape, footwear, laminates, ACP, pharma, FMCG, steel, packaging) and is implemented and supported directly by TechDotBit. It can integrate with Tally.
- AI services include AI agents, workflow automation, LLM development, AI-powered ERP, AI readiness assessments and responsible AI.
- Contact: https://techdotbit.com/contact-us/ or sales@techdotbit.com. Book a DotOne demo at https://dotone.in/demo.

- [DotOne product website](https://dotone.in/): Features, industries, modules, pricing and demo booking for DotOne.

## ERP by industry

- [Manufacturing ERP Software for Indian Factories](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/manufacturing-erp-software/): Plan, produce, cost and dispatch from one AI-powered manufacturing ERP built for Indian MSME factories.
- [ERP Software for Plywood Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/plywood-erp-software/): Plywood ERP that follows veneer, glue and press output to graded stock, dealer orders and dispatch, with sq ft and CBM built in.
- [ERP Software for Adhesive Tape Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/adhesive-tape-erp-software/): Tape ERP that tracks coating, jumbo rolls, rewinding and slitting with GSM, sq m yield and roll-wise cost.
- [ERP Software for Footwear Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/footwear-erp-software/): Footwear ERP for article and size-wise production, upper job work, soling, size-set packing and dealer sales.
- [ERP Software for Decorative Laminate Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/laminate-erp-software/): Laminate ERP for resin, impregnation, pressing, grading and design-wise dealer sales of HPL and pre-laminated boards.
- [ERP Software for ACP Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/acp-erp-software/): ACP ERP for coil coating, core extrusion, lamination, shade-wise stock, project orders and cost per sq ft.
- [ERP Software for Steel and Metal Industries](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/steel-metal-erp-software/): Steel and metal ERP for coils, heats, weight-based stock, slitting, fabrication, scrap and cost per MT.
- [ERP Software for FMCG Manufacturers and Brands](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/fmcg-erp-software/): FMCG ERP for batch production, expiry control, distributor schemes, claims, salesman apps and secondary sales.
- [ERP Software for Distributors and Wholesalers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/distribution-erp-software/): Distribution ERP for wholesalers and traders: multi-godown stock, principal claims, pricing, credit control and collections.
- [ERP Software for Textile and Garment Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/textile-garment-erp-software/): Textile and garment ERP for yarn, fabric, dyeing job work, cutting, stitching, trims, style-size stock and agents.
- [ERP Software for Packaging Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/packaging-erp-software/): Packaging ERP for corrugated boxes and flexibles: reels, specifications, cylinders, dies, wastage and job costing.
- [ERP Software for Plastic Moulding and Extrusion](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/plastic-erp-software/): Plastic ERP for moulding and extrusion: polymer stock, moulds, cycle times, regrind, rejection and part costing.
- [ERP Software for Chemical Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/chemical-erp-software/): Chemical ERP for formulations, reactor batches, QC and COA, assay-based stock, solvent recovery and batch costing.
- [ERP Software for Furniture Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/furniture-erp-software/): Furniture ERP for panel, solid wood and modular furniture: cut lists, hardware, projects, installation and dealer sales.
- [ERP Software for Auto Component Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/auto-components-erp-software/): Auto components ERP for OEM schedules, drawing revisions, job work, inspection, PPM, traceability and retro pricing.
- [ERP Software for Service Businesses](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/service-business-erp-software/): ERP for service businesses: AMC contracts, tickets, field technicians, spares, projects, timesheets and recurring billing.
- [Pharma ERP Software for Indian Drug Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/pharma-erp-software/): Pharma ERP that follows every API and packing material lot through batch manufacturing, QC release and dispatch with full traceability.
- [ERP Software for Dairy and Food Processing Units](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/dairy-food-processing-erp-software/): Dairy and food processing ERP covering milk procurement, fat and SNF balancing, batch production, shelf life, cold chain and route sales.
- [ERP Software for PVC and HDPE Pipe Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/pvc-pipe-erp-software/): Pipe ERP that follows resin through compounding and extrusion to length, class and size-wise stock, dealer orders and dispatch.
- [ERP Software for Wire and Cable Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/wire-cable-erp-software/): Wire and cable ERP that tracks metal through drawing, stranding and insulation to drum-wise stock, tenders, PV billing and dispatch.
- [ERP Software for Paper and Board Mills](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/paper-mill-erp-software/): Paper mill ERP that follows fibre, chemicals and machine output to reel-wise stock, deckle plans, sheet conversion and dispatch.

## ERP modules

- [Inventory Management Software for Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/inventory-management-software/): Real-time stock, batches, reorder levels and valuation across every store, plant and job worker.
- [Production Planning Software (PPC and MRP)](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/production-planning-software/): MRP, capacity scheduling, job cards and shop-floor tracking that connect sales demand to the factory.
- [Purchase Management Software for Indian Businesses](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/purchase-management-software/): Indents, quotations, approvals, purchase orders, GRN and invoice matching with GST input checks.
- [Sales Order Management Software for Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/sales-order-management-software/): Quotations, price lists, credit checks, delivery promises and GST invoicing in one connected order flow.
- [Quality Management Software for Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/quality-management-software/): Inspection plans, quality holds, NCR, CAPA and certificates linked to batches, vendors and production.
- [Dispatch and Logistics Software for Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/dispatch-logistics-software/): Dispatch planning, loading, GST documents, e-way bills, freight and proof-of-delivery in one flow.
- [Accounting and GST Software Built into Your ERP](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/accounting-gst-software/): Ledgers, GST returns data, e-invoice, TDS, bank reconciliation and MIS posted directly from operations.
- [HR and Payroll Software for Factories and MSMEs](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/hr-payroll-software/): Mobile attendance, shifts, overtime, statutory deductions and payslips linked to production and accounts.
- [ERP with CRM: Leads to Orders in One System](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/erp-crm-software/): Lead, pipeline and customer management connected to quotations, orders, stock and receivables.
- [Warehouse Management Software with Barcode and Bins](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/warehouse-management-software/): Bin locations, barcode and QR scanning, guided putaway, FIFO and FEFO picking and cycle counts.
- [BOM Management Software for Manufacturers](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/bom-management-software/): Multi-level bills of materials, routings, revisions, alternates and costing connected to planning and stock.
- [Costing Software for Job, Batch and Product Costing](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/costing-software/): Job, batch and product costing from actual consumption, labour, machine time and overheads.
- [ERP Reporting and Analytics: MIS, Dashboards, BI](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/erp-reporting-analytics/): MIS reports, live dashboards, drill-down analysis and an AI agent that answers business questions.
- [Mobile ERP App for Owners, Teams and Shop Floor](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/mobile-erp-app/): Approvals, dashboards, geo-fenced attendance, field sales, scanning and shop-floor entry on mobile.
- [Plant Maintenance Software for Factories](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/plant-maintenance-software/): Preventive schedules, breakdown work orders, spares, machine history and downtime analysis.
- [Batch Traceability Software: Lot Tracking End to End](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/batch-traceability-software/): Lot and batch genealogy from supplier receipt through production to customer dispatch, with expiry and recall support.
- [Job Work & Subcontracting Software](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/job-work-software/): Subcontract orders, job work challans, vendor stock, process loss, return deadlines and ITC-04 reporting for principals and job workers.
- [Shop Floor Tracking & OEE Software](https://techdotbit.com/erp-software/shop-floor-tracking/): Job cards, operation-wise output, machine and shift records, downtime reasons, OEE and live WIP captured from the shop floor.
